questions.answer: Living with the elderly day and night, foreign care workers often understand their needs better than anyone else.
accepted_answers: Living with elderly people day and night, foreign care workers often know what they need better than anyone else.
Staying with older people day and night, foreign caregivers usually understand their needs better than anyone else does.

questions.stem: 許多看護會去上由志工開設的中文課，中文說得越來越流利。
questions.answer: Many care workers take Chinese classes offered by volunteers and are speaking Chinese more and more fluently.
accepted_answers: Many caregivers attend Chinese classes run by volunteers and are becoming more and more fluent in Chinese.
Many care workers go to Chinese lessons taught by volunteers, and their Chinese is getting better and better.

patterns: 分詞片語後位修飾名詞（N＋p.p.＋by …）
越來越…（more and more／比較級 and 比較級）

1.explanation_zh: 前半句沒有主詞，主詞和後半句相同（外籍看護），用分詞構句 Living with the elderly day and night。「外籍看護」是 foreign care workers（或 caregivers）；「往往」是頻率副詞 often／usually，放在一般動詞前面。「比任何人都了解」是比較級：understand their needs better than anyone else；better 已是比較級，不加 more。「他們的需要」指長輩的需要，也可以寫成 the needs of the elderly，意思更清楚。
evidence: 比任何人都了解他們的需要
1.strategy_zh: 兩個子句主詞相同時，可以把前面的子句改成分詞構句：主動用 V-ing，被動用 p.p.。
hints: 切成四段：日夜和長輩住在一起／外籍看護往往／比任何人都／了解他們的需要
標的詞彙：elderly（年長的）、foreign（外國的）、care worker（看護）、understand（了解）、need（需要）
句型框架：V-ing …, S + often + V + better than anyone else

2.explanation_zh: 「由志工開設的中文課」是前置修飾，英文把名詞 Chinese classes 放前面，後面直接接過去分詞片語 offered by volunteers（課是被開設的，用 p.p.；也可以用 run／taught／held by volunteers）。「會去上」表示經常這樣做，用現在式 take／attend。「中文說得越來越流利」主詞是看護：are speaking Chinese more and more fluently（修飾動詞用副詞 fluently），或 are becoming more and more fluent in Chinese（be／become 後面用形容詞 fluent）。
2.strategy_zh: 「由…＋動詞＋的＋名詞」常譯成「名詞＋p.p.＋by …」：classes offered by volunteers、products made in Taiwan。
hints: 切成四段：許多看護會去上／由志工開設的／中文課／中文說得越來越流利
標的詞彙：care worker（看護）、volunteer（志工）、offer（開設）、class（課）、fluent（流利的）
句型框架：S + V + N + p.p. + by … and + be + V-ing + more and more + adv.

「往往」是「常常、通常」，用 often／usually 或 tend to；always 是「總是、一定」，語氣太強。
better 已經是比較級，前面不加 more。

間接問句用直述句語序。

traps.literal_error: Live with the elderly day and night, foreign care workers often …
traps.explanation_zh: 前半句中文沒有主詞，英文不能直接放原形動詞；主詞和後半句相同時用分詞構句 Living …。

traps.literal_error: foreign care workers often understand their needs more better than anyone
traps.explanation_zh: well 的比較級是 better，不能再加 more。

bonus.text: No one understands the needs of the elderly better than the foreign care workers who live with them day and night.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用 No one … better than … 的否定比較表示「最了解」，再用關係子句說明看護的身分；句構不同但語意相同，屬加分寫法。

traps.explanation_zh: 修飾動詞 speak 要用副詞 fluently；用形容詞 fluent 時要搭配 become／be fluent in Chinese。

2.restructuring_zh: 「由志工開設的中文課」是前置修飾，英文要改成名詞在前、過去分詞片語在後：Chinese classes offered by volunteers；「中文說得越來越流利」以看護為主詞，寫成 are speaking Chinese more and more fluently 或 are becoming more and more fluent in Chinese。

1.translation: Living with the elderly day and night, foreign caregivers often understand their needs better than anyone else.
1.explanation_zh: 前半句「日夜和長輩住在一起」與主句同主詞（外籍看護），用現在分詞片語 Living with ... 當副詞修飾最自然；「比任何人都了解」用比較級 better than anyone else（要加 else，否則把自己也比進去）；「往往」譯 often；「長輩」在看護的語境裡指受照顧的老人，用 the elderly。their 指長輩，語境清楚。

2.translation: Many caregivers attend Chinese classes offered by volunteers, and they are becoming more and more fluent in Chinese.
2.explanation_zh: 「由志工開設的中文課」是後位修飾，用過去分詞片語 offered by volunteers（也可說 taught／run by）；「會去上」譯 attend（或 take）；後半「中文說得越來越流利」主詞是看護，補 and they 連成一句，用 become more and more fluent in Chinese（越來越＋比較級重複），進行式表示逐漸變化。

issues_zh: 第 3 個參考譯文（索引 2）「their Chinese is getting better and better」只說「中文越來越好」，沒有譯出「流利」，語意偏鬆；它能通過標的詞彙檢查，是因為 fluent 的 alternatives 放了 better，但 better 不是 fluent 的同義詞（是 good／well 的比較級），等於用替換字繞過標的詞彙。

建議把參考譯文 3 改成 「Many care workers go to Chinese lessons taught by volunteers, and their Chinese is getting more and more fluent.」，並把 better 從 fluent 的 alternatives 拿掉；第 4 部分 accepted 裡的 better and better 寫法要不要保留給學生得分可另外決定，但不宜放在參考譯文。

problems: 第 2 題驗證者對參考譯文有意見（warn）：第 3 個參考譯文（索引 2）「their Chinese is getting better and better」只說「中文越來越好」，沒有譯出「流利」，語意偏鬆；它能通過標的詞彙檢查，是因為 fluent 的 alternatives

1.translation: Living with the elderly day and night, foreign caregivers often understand their needs better than anyone else does.
1.explanation_zh: 前半「日夜和長輩住在一起」與後半的主詞相同（外籍看護），可用現在分詞片語 Living with the elderly day and night 當分詞構句，表原因兼伴隨；「比任何人都了解」用比較級 better than anyone else（does 可省略），「往往」放在一般動詞前用 often。「長輩」譯成 the elderly，their needs 指他們（長輩）的需要。

2.translation: Many caregivers take Chinese classes offered by volunteers, and they speak Chinese more and more fluently.
2.explanation_zh: 「由志工開設的中文課」用過去分詞片語 offered by volunteers 後置修飾 Chinese classes；「說得越來越流利」用 more and more fluently 表示程度逐漸增加（也可寫成 are becoming more and more fluent in Chinese）。兩個分句之間中文沒有明確因果，所以用 and 連接而不加 so。信心 medium 是因為「越來越流利」有副詞與形容詞兩種合理寫法。

status_reason: 判定者人工審查（第 2 輪）：參考譯文與評分規準有實質問題。第 2 題參考譯文 R3「Many care workers go to Chinese lessons taught by volunteers, and their Chinese is getting better and better.」把「流利」譯成 better，只表達「中文越來越好」，漏掉「流利」的語意；它能通過「每個參考譯文都含每個標的詞彙」的檢查，是因為標的詞彙 fluent 的 alternatives 放了 better，但 better 是 good／well 的比較級，不是 fluent 的換字（README §3.5：alternatives 是可替換的換字），等於用 alternatives 繞過標的詞彙（驗證者 A 判 warn）。第 4 部分 accepted 也因此把 their Chinese is getting better and better、are speaking Chinese better and better、speak Chinese better and better 三種漏譯「流利」的寫法列為滿分寫法。重生時 R3 改成含 fluent 的寫法（例如 their Chinese is getting more and more fluent），把 better 從 fluent 的 alternatives 刪掉，第 4 部分刪除 better and better 系列（或改列為常見錯誤：語意不完整）。第 1 題沒有問題。
